actual.titulo: DP World Tour Golf • Alfred Dunhill Links Championship, First Round
actual.descripcion: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship, First Round | DP World Tour stars open Round 1 of the 2026 Alfred Dunhill Links Championship. Competitors begin their rotation across the Old Course at St Andrews, Carnoustie, and Kingsbarns, battling coastal links conditions for a share of the $5 million purse.
